help.title: Need help?
help.intro: If you're unable to scan the QR code, enter the activation code provided to you.
help.q1: I already have a {{brand}} Wallet. Do I need to create a new account?
help.a1: No. During setup, your existing credentials will be recovered.
help.q2: What if I'm using a new device?
help.a2: You'll be guided through the steps required to securely access your existing {{brand}} account.
help.q3: Can I continue without installing the Wallet?
help.a3: Yes. You can continue in your browser, although some features may be limited.

ios-install.title: Activate your credential in Wallet
ios-install.subtitle: On iPhone, links and QR codes opened from the camera or email cannot deliver credentials directly to wallet apps. Install Wallet, then scan the QR code from your email inside the app.
ios-install.steps-aria: Steps to install the wallet on iOS
ios-install.learn-more-body: Apple isolates the storage (credentials, session) of installed apps from Safari. If you register in Safari and later install the app, you would lose all your data and need to re-register. Installing first avoids this problem.
ios-install.confirm-message: If you continue without installing Wallet, you will not be able to receive your credential here. The credential will not transfer to the installed app later.
ios-install.already-bootstrapped-subtitle: On iPhone, links and QR codes opened from the camera or email cannot deliver credentials directly to wallet apps. Open Wallet from your home screen and scan the QR code from your email inside the app.
ios-install.standalone-divergence-title: Session not found in this app
ios-install.standalone-divergence-subtitle: If you had credentials or a session in Safari, they are not available here. Please re-authenticate and import your credentials.
ios-install.step6: Scan the QR from inside Wallet
ios-install.step6-detail: Important: use the Wallet scanner, not your iPhone camera. Tap 'QR Scan' inside Wallet to open the scanner.
ios-install.step5: Open Wallet from your home screen
ios-install.step5-detail: Tap the Wallet icon you just added
ios-install.step4-detail: Confirm to install Wallet on your home screen
ios-install.step3-detail: Scroll down in the share sheet if you don't see it
ios-install.step2-detail: Look for the share icon (box with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari
ios-install.step1: Tap the three dots in Safari
ios-install.step1-detail: Look for them next to the address bar to open the options menu

hybrid-onboarding.title: Signing from multiple devices
hybrid-onboarding.subtitle: This tenant uses a hybrid key manager. Credentials are signed with a passkey bound to this device. Signing from another device will fail.
hybrid-onboarding.bullet-1: The signing key is bound to this device
hybrid-onboarding.bullet-2: You will not be able to present credentials from another device
hybrid-onboarding.bullet-3: If you change devices, contact support
hybrid-onboarding.learn-more-body: This tenant uses passkeys with the PRF extension to protect the holder's private key. The passkey only exists on this device and cannot be transferred to another for security reasons.

hybrid-errors.wrap-unavailable-body: The signing key was created on another device and cannot be used here. Use the original device to present your credentials.
